title: Robin in the Hood
style: Hyper-speed heist pop-R&B with frenetic breakbeat bounce and 90s-leaning smooth chords; verse drives fast with clipped drum hits, rubbery bass, and whispered crew chants; pre-chorus strips to handclaps and rising synth smears; chorus slams with stacked gang vocals, bright stabs, and short delay throws on the anchor phrase. Vocal is close-mic and urgent in verses, doubled and ad-libbed on hooks, with siren FX, vinyl crackle, and reverse swells into drops. Clean, punchy, kinetic mix., r&b, bounce, fake, rock
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Math Driver on the map
Delta, alpha, plan
Take the right lane, hold it
We move quick, never pan

Sirens talk, let them
Unit three-three-six
Got my boys in the back
Thrash this toy to bits

[Pre-Chorus]
Chase and cage, then we slip
Fake a break, then we dip
Cash back drop, what a shock
Free birds rock, watch us flip

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in a hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good

A robin in the hood
A robin in a hood
Bust 'em like we should
Ha, bro, if we could

[Verse 2]
Out the mansion, gone
Leave a stripe, no rage
Sneaky thrift drift kick
Tear the lock from the page

Phonky footsteps, hush
Police chatter in the wire
I can, you got this
We believe, then we fly higher

[Pre-Chorus]
Chase and cage, then we slip
Fake a break, then we dip
Cash back drop, what a shock
Free birds rock, watch us flip

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in a hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good

A robin in the hood
A robin in a hood
Bust 'em like we should
Ha, bro, if we could

[Bridge]
Math Driver, architect
Draw the dream, lock the route
Three mirrors in the dark
Make the whole block doubt

No slow hands, no pause
Just the pulse, just the run
Our robin, our robin
In our hood, we done

[Final Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in a hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good

A robin in the hood
A robin in a hood
Bust 'em like we should
Ha, bro, if we could
